# sigma_workspace (Resource)

A Sigma workspace. Workspaces group content and have their own permission grants (4-permission scheme: view, explore, organize, edit).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A top-level workspace folder.
# CAUTION: destroy is unrecoverable. Anything inside is gone with the workspace.
resource "sigma_workspace" "analytics" {
  name = "analytics"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Workspace name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Workspace UUID.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `workspace_url_id` (String) Base62-encoded ID used in workspace URLs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_workspace.example '<workspace_id>'
```
